Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rules 212 and 214 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (“Commission”), 18 C.F.R. §§ 385.212 and 385.214, Google LLC (“Google”) hereby moves to intervene in this proceeding. Google is a direct, wholly-owned subsidiary of Alphabet, Inc. Google’s mission is to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful. Data centers necessary to serve Google’s customers are located across the U.S. and require reliable electric service to operate. Google has a direct and substantial interest in the outcome of this proceeding, and its interests cannot be adequately represented by any other party. Accordingly, Google respectfully requests that the Commission grant its motion to intervene in this proceeding.
